lines.en: Today the weather is very clear.
Minsu packs a shopping bag.
He walks to the neighborhood market.
There is a delicious smell in the market.
First, he found the fruit shop.
There are red apples in front of the shop.
The scent of the apples is very sweet.
Minsu picks big apples.
The kind shop owner smiles.
The owner also gives a yellow tangerine.
Please taste this one as well.
Minsu greets the owner with joy.
He returns home with a light heart.

check.q: Where does Minsu go today?
check.a: He goes to the neighborhood market.

check.q: What kind of fruit does Minsu pick?
check.a: He picks big red apples.

check.q: What extra fruit does the shop owner give to Minsu?
check.a: The owner gives him a yellow tangerine.

lines.en: Tomorrow is Hana's birthday.
Jisu goes to buy a gift.
She entered a nearby bookstore.
There are really many books in the bookstore.
Jisu discovers a pretty notebook.
The notebook cover is blue.
She also chooses a flower postcard.
She finished paying at the counter.
Jisu sat down in a cafe.
She writes a congratulatory letter on the postcard.
Happy birthday, my friend.
She hopes that Hana will be pleased.

check.q: Whose birthday is tomorrow?
check.a: Tomorrow is Hana's birthday.

check.q: What color is the cover of the notebook?
check.a: The cover of the notebook is blue.

check.q: Where does Jisu write the letter?
check.a: She writes the letter in a cafe.

title.en: The Yellow Umbrella on a Rainy Day

lines.en: The sky was blue in the morning.
Hana went out without an umbrella.
It suddenly became dark in the afternoon.
Rain pours down from the sky.
Hana runs to a convenience store.
She bought a small yellow umbrella.
She opened the umbrella and went to a cafe.
She drank warm tea.
She forgot the umbrella when leaving.
The staff member brought the umbrella to her.
Customer, you left your umbrella behind.
Hana bows her head and expresses thanks.

check.q: Why did Hana go out without an umbrella?
check.a: Because the sky was blue in the morning.

check.q: Where did Hana buy the yellow umbrella?
check.a: She bought it at a convenience store.

check.q: Who returned the forgotten umbrella to Hana?
check.a: The staff member brought the umbrella to her.

lines.en: Minsu goes to the river today.
He walks down into the subway station.
He tapped his transportation card on the machine.
The subway train arrived quickly.
Minsu sits down in an empty seat.
The train runs fast.
He listens carefully to the station announcements.
Minsu gets off at the transfer station.
He walks following the blue sign.
He transferred smoothly to another train.
He arrived safely at the destination station.
A refreshing river breeze blows.

check.q: Where is Minsu going today?
check.a: He is going to the river.

check.q: What does Minsu tap on the machine?
check.a: He taps his transportation card.

check.q: What color sign does Minsu follow to transfer?
check.a: He follows the blue sign.

lines.en: Today is a leisurely Saturday.
Jisu is a little hungry.
She opens the kitchen refrigerator door.
There is well-fermented kimchi.
She decides to make kimchi fried rice.
She chops the kimchi on the cutting board.
She swirls cooking oil in the frying pan.
She stir-fries the rice and kimchi together.
A savory smell spreads throughout the room.
She also places a fried egg nicely on top.
She sits at the table and eats the meal.
The food she made herself is truly delicious.

check.q: What day of the week is it in the story?
check.a: It is a leisurely Saturday.

check.q: What dish does Jisu decide to make?
check.a: She decides to make kimchi fried rice.

check.q: What does Jisu put on top of the fried rice?
check.a: She places a fried egg on top.

lines.en: All classes are finished.
Minsu heads to the art room.
There are many drawing tools in the art room.
Minsu likes drawing pictures.
An apple is placed on top of the desk.
He spreads white paper on the desk.
He holds a pencil and draws the apple.
He slowly draws the round shape.
The teacher comes over and looks at the drawing.
The teacher compliments him brightly.
The lines are very soft and nice.
Minsu looks forward to next week as well.

check.q: Where does Minsu go after class?
check.a: He goes to the art room.

check.q: What object is placed on the desk to draw?
check.a: An apple is placed on the desk.

check.q: What does the teacher say about Minsu's drawing?
check.a: The teacher says that the lines are very soft and nice.

lines.en: Hana arrived at work early today.
The office is still very quiet.
She opens the window to freshen the air.
She prepares a cup of warm tea.
She turned on the computer power.
She reviews today's meeting documents.
Her colleague Jisu walks into the office.
The two exchange pleasant morning greetings.
Did you finish preparing for today's meeting?
Hana smiles and nods her head.
They look at the prepared presentation materials together.
They start an energetic day delightfully.

vocab.en: to go to work, to arrive at work

check.q: Why is the office very quiet when Hana arrives?
check.a: Because Hana arrived at work early today.

check.q: Who enters the office after Hana?
check.a: Her colleague Jisu enters the office.

check.q: What do Hana and Jisu review together?
check.a: They look at the prepared presentation materials together.

lines.en: Jisu has a stinging sore throat from the morning.
Coughing also begins to emerge little by little.
Jisu drinks some warm water.
She puts on clothes and heads to the clinic.
She stated her name at the reception desk.
The doctor examines her throat.
Your throat is quite red and swollen.
The doctor prescribed medicine for her.
Jisu stops by the pharmacy downstairs.
She greets the pharmacist and receives the medication.
She returns home and rests warmly.
She hopes she will feel better tomorrow.

check.q: What symptoms does Jisu have in the morning?
check.a: She has a sore throat and coughing.

check.q: What does the doctor say after examining Jisu's throat?
check.a: The doctor says that her throat is red and swollen.

check.q: Where does Jisu pick up her prescribed medicine?
check.a: She picks up her medicine at the pharmacy downstairs.

lines.en: Everyone woke up on Sunday morning.
Today is the whole family's cleaning day.
The father first runs the vacuum cleaner.
The mother dusts off dust from high places.
Minsu rinses the cleaning rag in water.
He wipes the living room floor cleanly.
He wiped every corner cleanly.
The whole house sparkles and shines.
The cleaning is finally completely finished.
The mother slices some sweet watermelon.
Everyone sits around together in the living room.
They enjoy eating the cool fruit delightfully.

check.q: What special chore does the family do on Sunday morning?
check.a: They do house cleaning together.

check.q: What task does Minsu do during cleaning?
check.a: He rinses the rag and wipes the floor.

check.q: What snack does the family eat together after cleaning?
check.a: They eat sweet cool watermelon together.

lines.en: Hana made plans with Jisu today.
They decided to meet at two in the afternoon.
Hana arrived at the front gate of the library.
Looking at the watch, it is exactly two o'clock.
However, Jisu is nowhere to be seen.
Hana pulls her phone out of her pocket.
She made a phone call to Jisu.
Jisu, where are you right now?
Jisu answers with a chuckle.
I am at the back gate of the library.
Hana walks quickly towards the back.
The two see each other and smile broadly.

vocab.en: to make an appointment, to promise

check.q: What time did Hana and Jisu agree to meet?
check.a: They agreed to meet at two in the afternoon.

check.q: Where was Hana waiting at first?
check.a: She was waiting at the front gate of the library.

check.q: Where was Jisu actually waiting?
check.a: Jisu was waiting at the back gate of the library.
